notes.title: Full Release is Here!
notes.content:
You Are The Code is now out of Early Access!

Notable changes since the initial July Early Access release:
30 new levels! Bringing the total to 150!

New mechanics!

Escaping from "You Are The Code Operating System" (YATC-OS) is now possible!

Steam Workshop support! Make levels and share them with the community!

Lore!

New Achievements!

notes.title: Hotfix for alphabet and missing word
notes.content:
A bug snuck into the previous build that made alphabet level 2 and missing word level 4 unsolvable. This has now been fixed! 

Tests have been added for this case so it should be much harder for bugs like this to occur in the future

notes.title: New Public Beta Branch - 4 New Levels - Blackout Curtain
notes.content:
Blackout Curtain
The public beta branch is out for You Are The Code! 4 new levels in a new folder, "blackout_curtain/", are awaiting your feedback. Save data is stored separately from the main game.


Joining The Beta
In your steam library, right click You Are The Code -> properties -> click the "betas" tab -> beta participation -> "beta ..."

notes.title: Hotfix: Fixes Gems Getting Deleted
notes.content: A hotfix has been released to address a bug that caused players to lose gems, and therefore unable to progress. If this happened to you, your save should automatically fix itself.
